verdict.rationale: Jan explicitly lists 'Model Context Protocol: MCP integration for agentic capabilities' as a first-party feature, confirming users can plug in MCP servers for tool use. However, evidence is limited to short marketing bullet points with no detailed documentation, setup guide, or independent hands-on confirmation of how MCP servers are configured or used. Missing for 10: detailed docs on adding/configuring MCP servers, independent/community verification of MCP working in practice, list of supported MCP server types.
